paper.title: Online Learning of Optimally Diverse Rankings

settings.name_in_paper: Online learning of diverse rankings with hidden query topics (cascading-click model)
unmapped: Each round a hidden topic m(n) is drawn i.i.d. from unknown distribution phi over M topics; topic is revealed only through the click
N items partitioned into M known topics; item k has CTR theta_{km}=0 unless k is in topic m
Ordered list of L items out of N; user clicks first relevant item; reward 1 if any click
settings.definition_quote: The set $\mathcal{ N}$ of $N$ items is partitioned into $M$ non-overlapping subsets ... The decision maker is aware of this partition. ... we assume that $\theta_{km}=0$ whenever $k\notin \mathcal{ N}_m$ ... the topic of the $n$-th query, denoted by $m(n)$, is unknown. $(m(n))_{n\ge 1}$ is an i.i.d sequence ... with distribution $\phi$, also unknown ... $R^\pi(T) = T\mu(u^\star) - \EE[\sum\limits_{n=1}^T \mu(u^{\pi}(n))]$.

symbols.I_y_k: I(nu(L|y^k)+delta, nu(L|u*)): Bernoulli KL between success rate of k in last slot of optimal list (plus delta) and that of the last optimal item
symbols.I_w_k: I(phi_{h(k)} theta_{k h(k)}+delta, phi_{h(k)} theta_{L_k h(k)}-delta)
symbols.C_NLdelta: constant C(N,L,delta) depending on number of items N, list length L and delta (explicit bound given, involving further finite constants C_1, C_2)

conditions: k is a suboptimal item (k > L)
delta in (0, Delta) for an instance-dependent separation Delta (per proof)

source.label: th:DiversiPIERegret
source.quote: There exists a constant $C(N,L,\delta)$ depending on $N, L$ and $\delta$, and a round $n_0$ such that under the LDR algorithm, we have: $\forall T>n_0$, $\delta>0$ and $\forall k>L$, \EE[\sum_{n=1}^T\mathbbm{1}[k\in u(n)]\leq \frac{f(T) }{ I(\nu(L|y^k) + \delta, \nu(L|u^\star))}+ \frac{f(T)}{I(\phi_{h(k)} \theta_{k h(k)}+\delta, \phi_{h(k)} \theta_{L_k h(k)}-\delta)}+ C(N,L,\delta).

results.notes: Bound on expected number of rounds a suboptimal item k is displayed. C(N,L,delta) has an explicit upper bound in the theorem containing unspecified finite constants C_1, C_2. Proof restricts delta to (0, Delta).

symbols.Delta_y_k: mu(u*) - mu(y^k), y^k = u* with last item replaced by k
symbols.Delta_w_k: mu(u*) - mu(w^k), w^k = k prepended to u*
symbols.I_w_k: I(phi_{h(k)} theta_{k h(k)}+delta, phi_{h(k)} theta_{L_k h(k)}-delta), Bernoulli KL

conditions: sum over suboptimal items k > L (not in u*)
results.notes: Regret defined through mean list rewards, hence pseudo-regret. Sum over N-L suboptimal items gives O((N-L) log T). Statement's first denominator has '-delta' while the proof version omits it.

symbols.Delta_u_k: mu(u*) - mu(u^k), u^k = best list with item k in the first slot
symbols.I_B_k: min over bad parameters lambda in B_k(theta) of I(theta_{k h(k)}, lambda_{k h(k)})

conditions: uniformly good: R(T) = o(T^a) for all a > 0 on all instances
proved for an easier model where an oracle reveals phi and the query topic after each round; holds a fortiori for the original model

source.label: th:LowBoundRew1
source.quote: For any parameter $(\phi,\theta)\in\Lambda\times \Theta$, and for any uniformly good policy $\pi\in \Pi$, we have: $$\lim\inf_{T\to\infty} \frac{R^\pi(T)}{\log(T)} \ge \sum_{k > L} \frac{\mu(u^\star) - \mu(u^k)}{\min_{\lambda\in B_k(\theta)} I(\theta_{kh(k)},\lambda_{kh(k)})}.$$

results.notes: Scales as Theta((N-L) log T). Derived via Graves-Lai controlled Markov chain lower bound.
